ibram.definition: The Brazilian Institute of Museums, the federal agency responsible for national museum policy, including the National Museum Registry.

cadastro-nacional-de-museus.definition: A quantitative tool maintained by IBRAM that registers Brazil's museum institutions — the source of the museum counts cited in this digest.

plano-museologico.definition: A strategic-scope document, mandatory under the Brazilian Museum Statute (Law 11,904/2009), that characterizes a museum — its mission, values, and position within the programs set out by law.

pnem.definition: An IBRAM directive (Normative Resolution No. 40/2025) that systematizes the guidelines for the educational sector of Brazilian museums, organized into three axes: Management; Professionals, Training and Research; and Museums, Communities and Territories.

museologia.definition: The field of study of the museum. Still an emerging science, without consolidated recognition at the interfaces with other disciplines, in Brazil or elsewhere.

educacao-museal.definition: A non-formal learning process, decoupled from school education and Brazil's national curriculum, through which the museum carries out its social role and mediates with different publics.

design-de-servicos.definition: An approach that integrates end users' needs with the capabilities and goals of the organizations providing the service, using visual tools, collaborative processes, and a human-centered mindset.

estatuto-dos-museus.definition: Law No. 11,904 of January 14, 2009, which legally defines what counts as a museum in Brazil and sets obligations for these institutions.
